hints.title: Left Half Multiset Permutations
hints.text: The problem reduces to finding the k-th lexicographical permutation of the characters belonging to the first half.

hints.title: Multinomial Coefficient Counting
hints.text: Calculate the number of unique arrangements formed by remaining characters using multinomial coefficients.

hints.title: Greedy Character Selection
hints.text: At each position, try placing characters from a to z. If available permutations under that choice are less than k, subtract and move to the next character.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Multinomial permutation counts guide greedy prefix determination.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating permutations one by one times out for large k.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Combinatorial counts pinpoint characters without generating invalid strings.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply multinomial counting to isolate the lexicographical rank.
